---
title: "Datasets"
---

This section will contain small, documented datasets suitable for teaching evidence-synthesis methods.

Contributed datasets should include:

- a clear licence and source;
- a data dictionary;
- enough context to understand the teaching example;
- a distinction between original, simulated and modified data;
- scripts documenting any cleaning or transformation;
- no sensitive or personally identifying information.

Simulated data are welcome when they make an assumption or statistical behaviour easier to see.
